script_text: Stop! Gemini, Mercury is stationing direct today and your entire world is about to shift. Your ruling planet Mercury is forming a powerful trine with Jupiter in your 9th House of Expansion, while Venus squares your 10th House of Career, creating tension between your ambitions and your relationships. In love, a conversation you've been avoiding will surface unexpectedly — if you're single, someone from a completely different background catches your eye. Financially, a delayed payment or opportunity resurfaces through your 2nd House of Personal Resources, so check your accounts carefully. The warning: do not sign any contracts today, Mercury's shadow period still lingers. But here's your blessing — an old connection reaches out with news that changes your trajectory. Follow for tomorrow's reading so you don't miss what Jupiter has planned for you this week.
